mfaNote: Second factors are held by the sign-in provider, so EstatePro cannot count them.
targetNotSetLong: The response target is not set, so late replies are not counted.
checksExpiring: Identity checks due for renewal within 30 days
privacyNote: Access and erasure requests arrive with a later release; until then the count is not available.
scopeNote: Counts include only the offices you can see.
